info.title: msagent
info.description: AgentHost CLI is the CLI for working with the Microsoft Agent Hosting platform. This tool supports various commands for managing and interacting with the platform. The CLI currently supports Microsoft Copilot Studio Agents, and Agents developed with the Microsoft 365 Agents SDK.

Version: 0.2.198-beta+c0ec270c5b (.NET 10.0.15)

commands.name: copy

options.description: Display name of the new agent or workflow. Required.

options.name: --project
options.description: Local agent or workflow to copy: its folder, or a project holding only that agent or workflow. Defaults to the current directory. With --mcs-clone-agent-id or --mcs-clone-workflow-id, the project to register the copy in.
